Name: Galaxy Slingshot Obtainable
Author: Adham084
Description:
[size=6]Overview[/size]
The Galaxy Slingshot is an unobtainable weapon in the game.
This mod makes it obtainable, the only way to get it is from the adventurer's guild for only 25000g (Configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu) after getting the Galaxy Sword.

NOTE: This mod is a content pack now for 1.6 and will require Content Patcher.

If you have any suggestions for this mod, please let me know in the comments.
If you like this mod, feel free to give it a thumbs up and check my other mods.

[size=6]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "Stardew Valley/Mods".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
